title: Cursor Breach Spawns Malicious Claude Code Extension
excerpt: Cursor has confirmed a security breach enabled hackers to distribute a malicious Claude Code extension via its marketplace.
body_html:
Cursor has confirmed that it experienced a security breach. The incident enabled malicious actors to distribute a harmful Claude Code extension through the platform's marketplace.

According to the details, the attackers managed to steal credentials from Fireworks AI, an artificial intelligence infrastructure provider, which facilitated the distribution of the malicious extension.
